audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Abandonment, bodily suffering, ridicule, textual variants, public praise, poor people, and nations.

verses.restored: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?

familiar.text: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?

modern.text: My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Why are You so far from saving me, so far from my words of groaning?

original.text: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַל אַיֶּ֥לֶת הַשַּׁ֗חַר מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד אֵלִ֣י אֵ֭לִי לָמָ֣ה עֲזַבְתָּ֑נִי רָח֥וֹק מִֽ֝ישׁוּעָתִ֗י דִּבְרֵ֥י שַׁאֲגָתִֽי

verses.restored: O my God, I cry in the day time, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.

familiar.text: O my God, I cry in the day time, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.

modern.text: I cry out by day, O my God, but You do not answer, and by night, but I have no rest.

original.text: אֱֽלֹהַ֗י אֶקְרָ֣א י֭וֹמָם וְלֹ֣א תַעֲנֶ֑ה וְ֝לַ֗יְלָה וְֽלֹא דֽוּמִיָּ֥ה לִֽי

verses.restored: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

familiar.text: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

modern.text: Yet You are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.

original.text: וְאַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.

familiar.text: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.

modern.text: In You our fathers trusted; they trusted and You delivered them.

original.text: בְּ֭ךָ בָּטְח֣וּ אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ בָּ֝טְח֗וּ וַֽתְּפַלְּטֵֽמוֹ

verses.restored: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

familiar.text: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

modern.text: They cried out to You and were set free; they trusted in You and were not disappointed.

original.text: אֵלֶ֣יךָ זָעֲק֣וּ וְנִמְלָ֑טוּ בְּךָ֖ בָטְח֣וּ וְלֹא בֽוֹשׁוּ

verses.restored: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.

familiar.text: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.

modern.text: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by men and despised by the people.

original.text: וְאָנֹכִ֣י תוֹלַ֣עַת וְלֹא אִ֑ישׁ חֶרְפַּ֥ת אָ֝דָ֗ם וּבְז֥וּי עָֽם

verses.restored: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,

familiar.text: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,

modern.text: All who see me mock me; they sneer and shake their heads:

original.text: כָּל רֹ֭אַי יַלְעִ֣גוּ לִ֑י יַפְטִ֥ירוּ בְ֝שָׂפָ֗ה יָנִ֥יעוּ רֹֽאשׁ

verses.restored: He trusted on YHWH that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.

familiar.text: He trusted on the LORD that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.

modern.text: “He trusts in the LORD, let the LORD deliver him; let the LORD rescue him, since He delights in him.”

original.text: גֹּ֣ל אֶל יְהוָ֣ה יְפַלְּטֵ֑הוּ יַ֝צִּילֵ֗הוּ כִּ֘י חָ֥פֵֽץ בּֽוֹ

verses.restored: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother’s breasts.

familiar.text: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother’s breasts.

modern.text: Yet You brought me forth from the womb; You made me secure at my mother’s breast.

original.text: כִּֽי אַתָּ֣ה גֹחִ֣י מִבָּ֑טֶן מַ֝בְטִיחִ֗י עַל שְׁדֵ֥י אִמִּֽי

verses.restored: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother’s belly.

familiar.text: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother’s belly.

modern.text: From birth I was cast upon You; from my mother’s womb You have been my God.

original.text: עָ֭לֶיךָ הָשְׁלַ֣כְתִּי מֵרָ֑חֶם מִבֶּ֥טֶן אִ֝מִּ֗י אֵ֣לִי אָֽתָּה

verses.restored: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.

familiar.text: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.

modern.text: Be not far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.

original.text: אַל תִּרְחַ֣ק מִ֭מֶּנִּי כִּי צָרָ֣ה קְרוֹבָ֑ה כִּי אֵ֥ין עוֹזֵֽר

verses.restored: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.

familiar.text: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.

modern.text: Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.

original.text: סְ֭בָבוּנִי פָּרִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים אַבִּירֵ֖י בָשָׁ֣ן כִּתְּרֽוּנִי

verses.restored: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.

familiar.text: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.

modern.text: They open their jaws against me like lions that roar and maul.

original.text: פָּצ֣וּ עָלַ֣י פִּיהֶ֑ם אַ֝רְיֵ֗ה טֹרֵ֥ף וְשֹׁאֵֽג

verses.restored: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.

familiar.text: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.

modern.text: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are disjointed. My heart is like wax; it melts away within me.

original.text: כַּמַּ֥יִם נִשְׁפַּכְתִּי֮ וְהִתְפָּֽרְד֗וּ כָּֽל עַצְמ֫וֹתָ֥י הָיָ֣ה לִ֭בִּי כַּדּוֹנָ֑ג נָ֝מֵ֗ס בְּת֣וֹךְ מֵעָֽי

verses.restored: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.

familiar.text: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.

modern.text: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You lay me in the dust of death.

original.text: יָ֘בֵ֤שׁ כַּחֶ֨רֶשׂ כֹּחִ֗י וּ֭לְשׁוֹנִי מֻדְבָּ֣ק מַלְקוֹחָ֑י וְֽלַעֲפַר מָ֥וֶת תִּשְׁפְּתֵֽנִי

verses.restored: For dogs surround me; a band of evildoers encircles me; like a lion [at] my hands and my feet [textual reading disputed].

familiar.text: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.

notes.title: Hands and feet textual variant
notes.body: The Masoretic wording is commonly read “like a lion [at] my hands and feet,” while other witnesses and reconstructions support a verb interpreted as “dug/pierced.” This is a major textual variant and must remain visible.

modern.text: For dogs surround me; a band of evil men encircles me; they have pierced my hands and feet.

original.text: כִּ֥י סְבָב֗וּנִי כְּלָ֫בִ֥ים עֲדַ֣ת מְ֭רֵעִים הִקִּיפ֑וּנִי כָּ֝אֲרִ֗י יָדַ֥י וְרַגְלָֽי

verses.restored: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.

familiar.text: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.

modern.text: I can count all my bones; they stare and gloat over me.

original.text: אֲסַפֵּ֥ר כָּל עַצְמוֹתָ֑י הֵ֥מָּה יַ֝בִּ֗יטוּ יִרְאוּ בִֽי

verses.restored: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

familiar.text: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

modern.text: They divide my garments among them and cast lots for my clothing.

original.text: יְחַלְּק֣וּ בְגָדַ֣י לָהֶ֑ם וְעַל לְ֝בוּשִׁ֗י יַפִּ֥ילוּ גוֹרָֽל

verses.restored: But be not thou far from me, O YHWH: O my strength, haste thee to help me.

familiar.text: But be not thou far from me, O LORD: O my strength, haste thee to help me.

modern.text: But You, O LORD, be not far off; O my Strength, come quickly to help me.

original.text: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אַל תִּרְחָ֑ק אֱ֝יָלוּתִ֗י לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָׁה

verses.restored: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.

familiar.text: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.

modern.text: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of wild dogs.

original.text: הַצִּ֣ילָה מֵחֶ֣רֶב נַפְשִׁ֑י מִיַּד כֶּ֝֗לֶב יְחִידָתִֽי

verses.restored: Save me from the lion’s mouth, and from the horns of the wild oxen—you have answered me.

familiar.text: Save me from the lion’s mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.

modern.text: Save me from the mouth of the lion; at the horns of the wild oxen You have answered me!

original.text: ה֭וֹשִׁיעֵנִי מִפִּ֣י אַרְיֵ֑ה וּמִקַּרְנֵ֖י רֵמִ֣ים עֲנִיתָֽנִי

verses.restored: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.

familiar.text: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.

modern.text: I will proclaim Your name to my brothers; I will praise You in the assembly.

original.text: אֲסַפְּרָ֣ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְאֶחָ֑י בְּת֖וֹךְ קָהָ֣ל אֲהַלְלֶֽךָּ

verses.restored: Ye that fear YHWH, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.

familiar.text: Ye that fear the LORD, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.

modern.text: You who fear the LORD, praise Him! All descendants of Jacob, honor Him! All offspring of Israel, revere Him!

original.text: יִרְאֵ֤י יְהוָ֨ה הַֽלְל֗וּהוּ כָּל זֶ֣רַע יַעֲקֹ֣ב כַּבְּד֑וּהוּ וְג֥וּרוּ מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ כָּל זֶ֥רַע יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.

familiar.text: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.

modern.text: For He has not despised or detested the torment of the afflicted. He has not hidden His face from him, but has attended to his cry for help.

original.text: כִּ֤י לֹֽא בָזָ֨ה וְלֹ֪א שִׁקַּ֡ץ עֱנ֬וּת עָנִ֗י וְלֹא הִסְתִּ֣יר פָּנָ֣יו מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וּֽבְשַׁוְּע֖וֹ אֵלָ֣יו שָׁמֵֽעַ

verses.restored: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

familiar.text: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

modern.text: My praise for You resounds in the great assembly; I will fulfill my vows before those who fear You.

original.text: מֵ֥אִתְּךָ֗ תְֽהִלָּ֫תִ֥י בְּקָהָ֥ל רָ֑ב נְדָרַ֥י אֲ֝שַׁלֵּ֗ם נֶ֣גֶד יְרֵאָֽיו

verses.restored: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise YHWH that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.

familiar.text: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the LORD that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.

modern.text: The poor will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the LORD will praise Him. May your hearts live forever!

original.text: יֹאכְל֬וּ עֲנָוִ֨ים וְיִשְׂבָּ֗עוּ יְהַֽלְל֣וּ יְ֭הוָה דֹּ֣רְשָׁ֑יו יְחִ֖י לְבַבְכֶ֣ם לָעַֽד

verses.restored: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto YHWH: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.

familiar.text: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the LORD: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.

modern.text: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.

original.text: יִזְכְּר֤וּ וְיָשֻׁ֣בוּ אֶל יְ֭הוָה כָּל אַפְסֵי אָ֑רֶץ וְיִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לְ֝פָנֶ֗יךָ כָּֽל מִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת גּוֹיִֽם

verses.restored: For the kingdom is YHWH’s: and he is the governor among the nations.

familiar.text: For the kingdom is the LORD’s: and he is the governor among the nations.

modern.text: For dominion belongs to the LORD and He rules over the nations.

original.text: כִּ֣י לַ֭יהוָה הַמְּלוּכָ֑ה וּ֝מֹשֵׁ֗ל בַּגּוֹיִֽם

verses.restored: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.

familiar.text: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.

modern.text: All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; all who go down to the dust will kneel before Him— even those unable to preserve their lives.

original.text: אָכְל֬וּ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֨וּ כָּֽל דִּשְׁנֵי אֶ֗רֶץ לְפָנָ֣יו יִ֭כְרְעוּ כָּל יוֹרְדֵ֣י עָפָ֑ר וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ לֹ֣א חִיָּֽה

verses.restored: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.

familiar.text: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.

modern.text: Posterity will serve Him; they will declare the Lord to a new generation.

original.text: זֶ֥רַע יַֽעַבְדֶ֑נּוּ יְסֻפַּ֖ר לַֽאדֹנָ֣י לַדּֽוֹר

verses.restored: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.

familiar.text: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.

modern.text: They will come and proclaim His righteousness to a people yet unborn— all that He has done.

original.text: יָ֭בֹאוּ וְיַגִּ֣ידוּ צִדְקָת֑וֹ לְעַ֥ם נ֝וֹלָ֗ד כִּ֣י עָשָֽׂה

translation_notes: This chapter expands corpus coverage while remaining explicitly pending a deeper Hebrew/source-witness audit. KJV is retained only as the familiar comparison layer.

The completion draft intentionally preserves coherent traditional English syntax where a verse has not yet received a curated Hebrew-sensitive rendering; it does not mix archaic and modern grammar. Major identified lexical/textual issues receive explicit overrides and notes.
safety_note: This Jewish lament must not be erased by later Christian reception or used anti-Jewishly. Suffering language is not proof that victims were divinely abandoned.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Scrolls where extant, and other relevant witnesses during the global audit.
Preserve Psalm numbering and superscription differences across Hebrew and Greek traditions rather than silently harmonizing them.
